left.title: Kanye West Said His "Eyes Are Now Wide Open" After Realizing He's Been Used For Political Gain
left.body: "[I] now realize I’ve been used to spread messages I don’t believe in," Kanye tweeted. "I am distancing myself from politics and completely focusing on being creative!!"
left.roundup: Kanye West, a vocal supporter of President Trump, announced that he is "distancing" himself from politics after he was wrongly associated with helping spearhead "Blexit," a movement started by right-wing commentator Candace Owens which encourages blacks to leave the Democratic party. "I never wanted any association with Blexit. I have nothing to do with it," said West.
